subject: Missed war-room for DataSolve API incident — follow-up & new bridge
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@datasolve.com>, support@datasolve.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T07:12:00-07:00
Subject: Incident response war-room: DataSolve API anomaly - 10:00 AM PT today

Hi Alex and team,

We saw the spike and error-rate increase on your API this morning and want to get a focused war-room going. Proposed details: 

- Time: Today, 10:00 AM PT
- Purpose: Triage increased 500s and identify mitigation steps
- Bridge: zoom.us/j/987654321 (will open at 9:55)

Attaching recent logs we pulled for initial triage. If the time does not work, please propose the earliest alternate.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com

Attachments: incident_logs_20260519.zip (zip, 4.6MB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Incident response war-room: DataSolve API anomaly - 10:00 AM PT today

Team,

Quick update: Alex and support did not join the bridge at 10:00. Bridge was open, we had Redwood infra and CS on. I pinged again at 10:03 but no response.

Can we escalate and try a fallback bridge? Marissa, can you open an alternate meeting and share the link? Sean, please loop in the sales lead if we need any credits or SLA exceptions.

We should also confirm if DataSolve observed internal routing changes on their side; that could explain missing connection.

-J

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-05-19T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Incident response war-room: DataSolve API anomaly - alternate bridge

Thanks Jordan. I opened an alternate war-room and will host. New bridge below — please join as you can. I also uploaded the logs to the incident folder for the SREs.

- New bridge (temporary): https://zoom.us/j/1122334455
- Host: Marissa Cole (Redwood CS)
- Plan: 15 minute triage, then handoff to engineering if needed

I attached a trimmed log bundle that highlights the 09:42-09:58 window where the error rate spikes. If DataSolve can share their edge/router config or any deploys in that window, please drop them into the thread.

If we don't hear from the customer in 15 minutes we'll escalate to the on-call SRE and open a ticket for a post-incident deep-dive.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: incident_logs_20260519_trimmed.zip (zip, 1.2MB); notes.txt

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@datasolve.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Bridge details and next steps (DataSolve incident)

Alex,

We're on an alternate bridge now to triage — Marissa is hosting. Link: https://zoom.us/j/1122334455

If you can join, great. If you can't, please reply with the earliest time you can rejoin and any quick notes on whether you made config changes this morning. We want to avoid a multi-hour firefight so any detail helps.

Sean — flagging for potential executive update if the customer reports a config change.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive

From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@datasolve.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridge details and next steps (DataSolve incident)

Hey all,

Apologies — I was pulled into a higher priority call unexpectedly and missed the invite. Thanks for holding a fallback bridge and for the logs. I just joined the new bridge and can stay on for the triage.

Quick note from our side: we rolled a minor routing change at 09:40 PT for a canary, and SRE rolled it back at 09:58 PT. We're attaching a screenshot of the router metrics where you can see a brief latency jump.

I appreciate the quick response. Please proceed with the triage and let me know if you want any changes on our side or a follow-up post-mortem.

Alex Jones
Lead Platform Engineer, DataSolve Inc.
alex.jones@datasolve.com

Attachments: screenshot_error_100.png (png, 120KB)
